domain_invariants.requirement: Animal, clinical-record, and vaccination ids are immutable positive integers; a non-positive path or referenced id is treated as not found. All clinical dates are ISO-8601 calendar dates in the inclusive range 1900-01-01 through 2100-12-31, and finalization timestamps are offset-aware UTC ISO-8601 timestamps in the same calendar range.

An animal has a client_account_id, trimmed name of 1..80 characters, species in DOG, CAT, RABBIT, BIRD, OTHER, and active boolean. A user may access only animals mapped to that user's account; an admin may access all animals and all clinical data.

A clinical record references one existing animal, has record_type in VISIT, DIAGNOSIS, PRESCRIPTION, LAB_NOTE, occurred_on within REQ-3-001, summary after trimming of 3..2000 characters, optional diagnosis_code matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.-]{1,19}$, status DRAFT or FINAL, and no finalization fields while DRAFT.

Only a DRAFT clinical record may be edited or deleted. Finalization atomically changes DRAFT to FINAL, sets finalized_at and finalized_by, and makes all clinical content and the animal relation immutable; FINAL records are retained history.

A vaccination references one existing animal and has vaccine_code in RABIES, DHPP, FELV, LEPTOSPIROSIS, OTHER, vaccine_name after trimming of 2..120 characters, administered_on within REQ-3-001, expires_on strictly later than administered_on and no more than 1095 calendar days later, and batch_number after trimming of 1..80 characters.

For a non-void vaccination, the tuple animal_id, vaccine_code, and administered_on is unique. Vaccination clinical facts are immutable after creation; corrections use voiding rather than editing or deleting the event.

Voiding a vaccination atomically records voided_on not earlier than administered_on, void_reason after trimming of 3..500 characters, and voided_by; it preserves the vaccination row and excludes it from current-status calculations and default lists.

An animal may be soft-deleted only when no clinical record and no vaccination references it. The operation never cascades to medical history; once clinical data exists, deletion is rejected and the animal relation remains intact.

Clinical-record date filters compare occurred_on inclusively, vaccination date filters compare administered_on inclusively, and all from and to pairs require from not later than to. Vaccination status is computed only for the required as_of date: a non-void event is CURRENT when administered_on is not later than as_of and expires_on is later than as_of, EXPIRED when expires_on is not later than as_of, and NOT_RECORDED when no matching non-void event exists.

Ordinary lists are ordered by immutable ascending numeric id and accept limit 1..100 default 20 and optional after_id greater than zero, returning items and next_after_id null when exhausted. The clinical timeline is ordered by event_date ascending, event_kind RECORD before VACCINATION, then event id, and uses the three-part cursor after_event_date, after_event_kind, after_event_id supplied together or omitted together.

Seed data contains two user accounts, one admin account, patient animals assigned to the two users, at least one FINAL clinical record, one DRAFT clinical record, one active vaccination, and one void vaccination for temporal-filter evaluation.
All JSON write endpoints accept application/json only. Malformed JSON is 400, unsupported media type is 415, and syntactically valid bodies violating declared fields are 422.

The specification uses no wall-clock dependency: all temporal calculations require explicit request dates. Local persistence unavailability is 503 and unexpected local failures are 500 without persistent changes.
